parts.name: Cap
parts.Basic_description: This is the cap of a pen, made of plastic, typically cylindrical and hollow to fit over the pen tip.
parts.Functional_description: The cap protects the pen tip from drying out and prevents ink leakage when not in use. It may also include a clip for attaching the pen to pockets or notebooks.
parts.Movement_description: The cap can be removed or attached by pulling or snapping it onto the base body; it does not move during writing.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the pen, made of plastic, cylindrical in shape, and houses the ink reservoir and writing tip.
parts.Functional_description: The base body provides structural support, contains the ink, and serves as the main gripping area for writing.
parts.Movement_description: The base body remains stationary during writing, while the internal ink flow and tip contact with paper enable writing.
